aprasymas.title: Moderni Tvora
aprasymas.text: „Moderni Tvora“ is a company offering contemporary fencing solutions. Our professional team, with many years of experience, helps you choose the best fence, gate, and wicket options for your company or private plot, and carries out all installation work.

box1.title: Why Us?
box1.text: „Moderni Tvora“ uses the most advanced equipment, ensuring precise project execution. Our assortment includes only the highest quality materials, guaranteeing the durability of fences, gates, and wickets for your company or home.

box2.title: Work Guarantee
box2.text: We guarantee the quality of our work: a 2-year warranty for installation services, a 5-10 year warranty for fences, and up to 45 years for the metal sheets we use.

box3.title: Live Consultation at the Office
box3.text: Visit the „Moderni Tvora“ office in Marijampolė, where you can see our materials assortment in person, consult with our specialists about your project, and receive professional advice.

card1.title: Custom Projects
card1.text: For non-standard plots, we prepare individual plans, taking into account the unique terrain of the area, ensuring a perfect fence fit for your property.

card2.title: Speed
card2.text: High-quality and fast project implementation from planning to fence installation – one of the fastest in the Lithuanian market.

card3.title: Modern Measurements
card3.text: Using the most innovative equipment, we create precise 3D plans of the area, reflecting the specific terrain of your plot.

card4.title: Full Project Implementation
card4.text: Our experienced teams ensure a smooth process, from the initial measurement to the final installation of fences, gates, and wickets.

intro.title: Fences for your home and business
intro.text: We manufacture and install sheet metal and metal fences, fence boards and segment fences – for private yards and business premises. We help you choose the model and colour, measure the plot with 3D equipment and take care of all the work – from the first measurement to the installed fence.
intro.alt: Sheet metal fence and wicket next to a modern house

skardines-tvoros.short: Steel profile fences – solid or see-through, in various RAL colours. A modern solution for those who value privacy.
skardines-tvoros.title: Sheet metal fences – privacy and a modern look
skardines-tvoros.text: Sheet metal fences are assembled from galvanized and powder-coated steel profiles, so they resist corrosion and need no complicated maintenance. The profiles differ in shape and openness – from the diamond-shaped Daimond to the Žaliuzi fence that resembles window louvres – so you can choose how much privacy and light you want in your yard.

metalines-tvoros.short: Durable and good-looking metal fences for those who value strength and a long service life above all.
metalines-tvoros.title: Metal fences – a strong and long-lasting solution
metalines-tvoros.text: Metal fences are a durable and good-looking solution for private plots and business premises. We will help you choose the construction, height and colour, then manufacture the fence and install it.

tvoralentes.short: Metal fence boards – the look of a board fence without painting or maintenance. Installed one-sided or two-sided.
tvoralentes.title: Fence boards – the look of a board fence without the upkeep
tvoralentes.text: Fence boards are made of galvanized and painted metal, so they do not rust, fade or need maintenance. They are installed one-sided or two-sided – this is how you choose how open the fence is to views and wind.

segmentines-tvoros.short: Welded mesh panels – a cost-effective, easily installed enclosure for plots and business premises.
segmentines-tvoros.title: Segment fences – a reliable and cost-effective enclosure
segmentines-tvoros.text: A segment fence is assembled from welded mesh panels with a galvanized and powder-coated finish. It is a cost-effective and easily installed solution for private plots, business premises or car parks – the panels are available in several heights.

q1.q: How much does a fence cost?
q1.a: The price depends on the fence model, height and length, the terrain of the plot and the gates and wickets you choose. We prepare an exact offer after measuring the plot – get in touch and we will advise you.

q2.a: If privacy matters most, choose a sheet metal fence or fence boards. If you need a cost-effective enclosure, choose a segment fence. When we come to measure, we will advise what suits your plot and the architecture of your house best.

q3.q: Can I order gates and wickets together with the fence?
q3.a: Yes. We make sliding and swing yard gates and wickets filled with the same profile and in the same colour as the fence, so the whole enclosure looks consistent.

q4.a: We provide a 2-year warranty for the work carried out, fence boards come with a 5–10 year warranty, and the sheet metal we use is covered by a warranty of as much as 45 years.

intro.title: Yard gates and wickets that match your fence
intro.text: The gate is the first thing you see when you come home and the first thing your guests notice. We offer sliding and swing yard gates and wickets, made to your measurements and filled with the same profile as your fence. We take care of everything – from measuring and foundations to installation and setting up the automation.
intro.alt: Sliding yard gate and wicket with vertical infill

sliding.title: Sliding gates
sliding.text: A sliding gate opens by moving along the fence, so it takes no space in the yard or on the street. It is the most popular choice when the driveway is short, slopes upwards or the car is parked right behind the gate.
sliding.p1: No room needed for the leaves to swing – convenient in winter when snow builds up at the gate
sliding.p2: The gate runs on rollers fixed to a foundation, with no rail across the driveway
sliding.p3: Easy to automate and control with a remote or a phone

swing.title: Swing gates
swing.text: A swing gate is the classic two-leaf solution. It suits places where there is no room along the fence for a sliding gate to travel, while the yard has enough space for the leaves to open.
swing.p2: No free space needed along the fence
swing.p3: Can be automated right away or later

wicket.title: Wickets
wicket.text: Wickets are made in the same style as the gate and the fence, so the entrance to your yard looks consistent. They can be installed next to the gate or anywhere else in the fence line.
wicket.p2: Can be connected to an intercom or a keypad
wicket.p3: Width and height chosen to fit your entrance

infill.title: The same infill as your fence
infill.text: The gate and wicket frames are filled with the same profile and in the same colour as the fence, so the whole enclosure looks like one product. You can choose from our entire fence range.

automation.title: Gate automation
automation.text: We supply gates with automation from the trusted Italian manufacturers ROGER Technology and CAME. We choose the operator according to the gate type, weight and how often it is used, then install it, program it and show you how to use it.
automation.rogerText: Quiet, smooth operators for everyday use – for both sliding and swing gates.
automation.cameText: One of the best-known gate automation manufacturers in the world, with a wide choice of operators for gates of different sizes and weights.
automation.f1: Remote control, and phone control with an optional module
automation.f2: Safety photocells and a warning light
automation.f4: Manual release during a power cut

q1.q: Sliding or swing gate – which should I choose?
q1.a: A sliding gate is more convenient day to day and takes no space in the yard, but it needs free space along the fence – a little more than the width of the driveway. A swing gate does not need that space, but there must be room for the leaves to open. When we come to measure, we will advise what suits your plot best.

q2.q: Will the gate match my fence?
q2.a: Yes. Gates and wickets are filled with the same profile and in the same colour as the fence, so the enclosure looks consistent.

q3.a: Yes, but it is easier to plan for it from the start – the power cables are laid and the fixing points prepared when the gate is installed, so the paving does not have to be lifted later.

q4.q: Can I order just a gate, without a fence?
q4.a: Yes, gates and wickets can be ordered separately – we will match the infill and colour to your existing fence.

intro.title: Outdoor blinds for terraces, pergolas and facades
intro.text: Outdoor blinds are sheet metal blades used to build walls and roofs for terraces and pergolas, and screens for facades. They protect from the sun, the wind and prying eyes, and let light and air through when the blades are opened. We make the blinds from Arcelor Ultramatt steel to the lengths you specify, so they are easy to fit to a particular opening and to match with your fence or the facade of your house.
